content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm experiencing an unusual issue with my [product_name] system. It has now occurred twice: after a 24VDC power outage (the module is a [article_no] 12/24), when power returns, the base module unexpectedly switches its IP address to 192.168.1.111 instead of the configured one. Because this is a pure version (no display module), we lose all connectivity with the [product_name] installed on the front panel and also with the [product_name] modem. This results in no alarm notifications (aside from the general alarm light) and prevents any remote alerts. Has anyone encountered this problem or have any suggestions?
Is there an SD card inserted in the [product_name], which has a program saved with a different IP address?

analysis.insight_summary: Users report that the [product_name] base module, following a power failure and recovery, unexpectedly resets its IP address to a default value, causing network connection loss to devices like operator panels and communication modems. This leads to disruption of both alarm notifications and remote monitoring. Potentially, an SD card with a stored program config may be influencing this behavior, but the exact cause is still uncertain.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] base module to retain the configured IP address through power cycles, maintaining reliable connectivity to attached devices and ensuring alarms and remote notifications remain uninterrupted.
